name: steam-game-starter
description: A controller-first Three.js game starter for Steam Machine.
author: Jubishop

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run config:check && npm run art:check && npm run build
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux dir --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.shipit: npm run check && npm run deploy:steam
